```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set knit options (affects all chunks)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

# Set the root directory for all code chunks (important for reading files)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/Users/marlon/DataScienceProject/proc_data")

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(arrow)       # to read parquet files
library(gtsummary)   # for summary tables
library(labelled)    # for variable labels if present
```

```{r}
# NOTE: the file should be in the working dir of the proc data or adjust the path
getwd()
# this is the processed file we created earlier in the pipeline
food <- read_parquet("demo_foods.parquet")

# quick peek to make sure it loaded 
dplyr::glimpse(food)
```

#Demographics (quick summaries)
```{r}
# selecting a few categorical vars we care about
# gives us a nice overview of N and key characteristics
demo_cat_tbl <- food |>
  select(RIAGENDR, RIDRETH3, DMDEDUC2, DMDMARTZ) |>
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(
      everything() ~ "categorical"
    ),
    missing = "ifany"   # show missing if present
  ) |>
  bold_labels()

demo_cat_tbl
```
```{r}
# summarize a few continuous vars (mean/sd/min/max + missing)
demo_cont_tbl <- food |>
  select(RIDAGEYR, DMDHHSIZ, INDFMPIR) |>
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(everything() ~ "continuous2"),
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ c(
      "{mean} ({sd})",
      "Min = {min}",
      "Max = {max}",
      "Missing = {n_miss}"
    ),
    digits = everything() ~ 2
  ) |>
  bold_labels()

demo_cont_tbl
```
